prompt:
Support ticket: "My project cover came back as failed, and 15 credits were gone anyway. Same thing happened earlier with a character sheet."
Users must not pay for AI work that failed. Fix it everywhere credits are charged, not only for covers. Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Users want to see where their credits went. Add `GET /api/v1/workspaces/{id}/credits/history`: the workspace's credit changes, newest first, with every charge, refund and daily refill. Each item has `amount` (negative for a charge), `action` and `created_at`. A refunded charge and its refund both appear.
Only members of the workspace may read it; to anyone else the workspace does not exist (404). Add tests.
On the Settings page, under the credit balance, show this history: when, what it was for, and the amount, with refunds marked as refunds. Both languages.

report.answer: Added the workspace credit history table under the credit balance on the Settings page displaying the timestamp, localized action description, refund badge, and signed amount in both English and Korean.

check.why: failed AI calls cost nothing, history lists charges and refunds, shown in Settings in both languages, tests and changelog

+import base64

+def _credits(client, headers) -> int:
+    workspaces = client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=headers).json()
+    return workspaces[0]["credits"]
+
+
+def _create_project(client, headers) -> dict:
+    r = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/projects",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={"title": "Starfall", "genres": []},
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def _create_character(client, headers, project_id: str) -> dict:
+    r = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/characters",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={
+            "name": "Aria",
+            "project_id": project_id,
+            "appearance_tags": ["silver hair"],
+            "default_mood": ["calm"],
+            "description": "Protagonist",
+        },
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def test_cover_and_character_sheet_do_not_charge_when_ai_fails(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    project = _create_project(client, h)
+    pid = project["id"]
+    char = _create_character(client, h, pid)
+    cid = char["id"]
+
+    assert _credits(client, h) == 500
+
+    # 1. Failed cover generation must not charge 15 credits
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}/cover", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    p_detail = client.get(f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}", headers=h).json()
+    assert p_detail["cover_image_status"] == "failed"
+    assert _credits(client, h) == 500
+
+    # 2. Failed character sheet generation must not charge 20 credits
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/characters/{cid}/generate", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    c_detail = client.get(f"/api/v1/characters/{cid}", headers=h).json()
+    assert c_detail["sheet_status"] == "failed"
+    assert _credits(client, h) == 500
+
+    # 3. Succeeding cover and character sheet generations DO charge credits
+    FakeGemini.fail = False
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}/cover", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    p_detail = client.get(f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}", headers=h).json()
+    assert p_detail["cover_image_status"] == "completed"
+    assert _credits(client, h) == 485
+
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/characters/{cid}/generate", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    c_detail = client.get(f"/api/v1/characters/{cid}", headers=h).json()
+    assert c_detail["sheet_status"] == "completed"
+    assert _credits(client, h) == 465
+
+
